_comment: Copied to config.json by install.sh on first run; config.json is gitignored and never overwritten. Add thresholds.power_psu_watts for the power bar's dashed PSU line and its warning (power_warn_fraction of it), and power_max_watts to fix the bar's right edge; without them the bar scales to the reading. sensor_labels renames any sensor; fans sets per-fan rules (min_rpm, on_low, hide_if_zero; README). sensor_hide lists regexps of sensors to leave out (empty by default). zfs_pools names ZFS pools that must exist; zfs_scrub_max_days (default 38) is the oldest a finished scrub may be. limits.* are MB/s ceilings for each network interface and each drive (10 Gbit/s is 1250; a PCIe 5 NVMe about 15000): a sample over the cap counts as the cap and the record notes it under rate_capped; totals are sums and not capped. The server reads them at startup. http_targets lists URLs to check every services.check_interval seconds, e.g. {"name": "immich", "url": "http://box:2283/api/server/ping"}; optional "status": 200 requires that exact status (default: anything below 400), "insecure": true skips the TLS certificate check. config.json is served to every visitor, so put no passwords or tokens in a URL.
title: Horatio
